requirements: no mastery information conveyed by color alone
accessibility.math_access: Use readable Unicode/math text with explanatory language; avoid image-only mathematics. Future MathML enhancement must preserve plain-text fallback.
accessibility.accommodations: Timing, breaks, text size, read-aloud where permitted, alternate input, and reduced visual load may improve access without changing the mathematical target.

multilingual.fallback: English remains canonical when a translated instructional string is unavailable.
multilingual.translation_rule: Do not silently machine-translate scored question meaning or answer keys in the canonical assessment bank. Validated translations should carry their own version identifier and preserve the same skill ID and mathematical target.
multilingual.assessment_equivalence: Translated formal assessments require item-by-item equivalence review before certification.

offline.baseline: Core HTML, CSS, JavaScript, question banks, unit content, records, and localStorage progress do not require a remote application server after files are available to the browser.
offline.current_limit: Some registry-driven pages use fetch() for local JSON and therefore depend on the site files being reachable unless packaged/cached locally.
required_for_full_offline_certification: cache or package local JSON registries
cache canonical unit and assessment assets
test a cold reload after network removal
verify localStorage evidence persists independently of network state
offline.dependency_rule: No CDN, hosted font, analytics, external AI, or third-party account may be required for course completion.

tool_integration.principle: Tools may enhance learning but may not become hidden prerequisites.
tool_integration.privacy: Do not transmit learner identity, family identifiers, free-response text, credentials, or browser identifiers in curriculum-quality or recommendation signals unless a separate authorized identity layer explicitly requires it.
tool_integration.fallback: Every required learning, remediation, reassessment, and completion route must remain available without optional tools.
